column3: Is matching based on this page or the profile? Seeker currently has 4 places to search/match (Profile, Discover, Find Offerers, Seek Assistance). Want one place.
column4: Now one flow: PROFILE = what the seeker needs (areas + topics, set once) and drives the match score. FIND OFFERERS = the one place to search and see matched/ranked results. SEEK ASSISTANCE = the action - 'Request help' on any offerer opens it with that offerer pre-filled; seeker can still send to a whole category. Its 'My requests' tab is linked from the Dashboard. Discover and Top Matches no longer exist for seekers.
column5: Done - needs client sign-off on the flow
column6: Client to confirm: Profile drives matching, Find Offerers shows results, Seek Assistance sends the request. Backend needed so offerers are matched on topic (not just category) and so a request to one offerer only reaches that offerer.
column7: PARTLY - flow and links built. Seek requests save live (view 1819 number, SP 1821 header, SP 1822 detail, SP 1826/1827 attachments). Offerer inbox still matches on CATEGORY only.
column8: Topic(s) and the chosen offerer are stored as TEXT inside the detail line ('Topics: ... | To: ...') because no column exists - so a request sent to one offerer is still visible to all offerers in that category.
column9: (1) SEEK DETAIL TABLE with real IDs: SP params OT_SEEK_ASSISTANCE_ID, OT_TOPIC_ID, CREATEDELETE (one row per topic) + view returning seek id, topic id, topic name - so offerers can be matched on topic. (2) TARGET OFFERER on SP 1821: new param OT_TARGET_OFFERER_ID INT (0 = whole category) + same column on view 1818 - so a direct request only reaches that offerer. (3) OFFERER RESPONSE SP: seek id, offerer reg no, response text, date/time + RESPONSE VIEW (seek id, offerer id, text, date) - so the seeker sees who replied. (4) CLOSE/RESOLVE SP: seek id, closed flag (agreed values e.g. OPEN/CLOSED/RESOLVED), closed date, success/failure - currently OT_SEEKER_ASSISTANCE_CLOSED has no SP param. (5) Fix SP 1827 (images write into 1824 not 1825) and publish params for delete SP 1828; 1829 is a no-op.
